record.paper_title: Some open problems on well-filtered spaces and sober spaces
record.original_question: Characterize those directed complete posets P such that Sigma P is well-filtered and, for every directed complete poset Q whose Scott space Sigma Q is well-filtered, the product dcpo P x Q is again Scott well-filtered.

evidence.quote: Question 4.9. Characterize those Scott well-filtered dcpos P for which the products P × Q is Scott well-filtered for every Scott well-filtered dcpo Q.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Recall that a directed complete poset (dcpo) is a partially ordered set in which every directed subset has a supremum. The Scott topology on a dcpo $P$, denoted $\Sigma P$, has as open sets those upper sets $U \subseteq P$ such that whenever a directed set $D \subseteq P$ has $\sup D \in U$, then $D \cap U \neq \emptyset$. A topological space $X$ is called well-filtered if, whenever $\{K_i : i \in I\}$ is a filtered family of compact saturated subsets of $X$ (saturated meaning equal to the intersection of its open neighborhoods) and $U$ is an open set with $\bigcap_{i \in I} K_i \subseteq U$, then there exists $i \in I$ with $K_i \subseteq U$. A dcpo $P$ is called Scott well-filtered if $\Sigma P$ is well-filtered. The product dcpo $P \times Q$ is the Cartesian product with the coordinatewise order, which is again a dcpo.

Problem: Give an internal order-theoretic characterization of those Scott well-filtered dcpos $P$ with the property that for every Scott well-filtered dcpo $Q$, the product dcpo $P \times Q$ is also Scott well-filtered.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent literature on well-filtered dcpos (e.g., works on commutation of Smyth/Hoare power constructions and on Scott topology of products) continues to address related questions, but no published characterization of dcpos $P$ stable under product with arbitrary Scott well-filtered dcpos appears in available sources. The problem remains listed among open questions on well-filtered dcpos.

status_evidence.title: Commutation of Smyth and Hoare Power Constructions in Well-filtered Dcpos
status_evidence.snippet: Recent paper investigating structural properties of well-filtered dcpos; does not resolve the characterization of dcpos stable under products with well-filtered dcpos.
status_evidence.claim: Active research continues on well-filtered dcpos without resolving this characterization question.

status_evidence.title: Dcpos and convergence spaces II: preserving products
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses subtleties: the Scott topology of a product of dcpos may differ from the product of their Scott topologies, except for continuous dcpos.
status_evidence.claim: The product behavior of Scott topology on dcpos is known to be delicate, motivating the open characterization question.
